> Meet Transfer is Turkey's leading private airport transfer and chauffeur service. We provide fixed-price, professional door-to-door transfers across Turkey, Dubai, Cyprus, Greece, Switzerland and Germany with licensed drivers and luxury Mercedes vehicles. 50,000+ satisfied customers, 4.7★ Google rating, 11 languages supported.

## Core Services

### Airport Transfer Service
**URL**: https://meettransfer.app/services
Private airport transfers in Istanbul, Antalya, Bodrum, Izmir, Cappadocia, Ankara, Bursa, Dubai and 81 Turkish cities. Professional meet & greet at arrivals, flight tracking, fixed pricing. Mercedes fleet with sedan, minivan, VIP and Maybach options.

### Instant Vehicle Service
**URL**: https://meettransfer.app/blog/instant-vehicle-service-guide
Book a vehicle and get it at your door in 20 minutes with fixed pricing. Select your location, choose your vehicle type, and a professional driver arrives within 20 minutes. Available across Turkey with round-trip 25% discount.

### Intercity Transfer
**URL**: https://meettransfer.app/blog/intercity-transfer-turkey
City-to-city private transfers across Turkey. Door-to-door service between any two cities with fixed pricing, professional drivers, and comfortable Mercedes vehicles. Popular routes include Istanbul–Bursa, Istanbul–Ankara, Antalya–Cappadocia.

### Hourly Chauffeur Service
**URL**: https://meettransfer.app/luxury-chauffeur
Hire a professional driver with a luxury Mercedes vehicle by the hour. Perfect for city tours, business meetings, shopping trips, and special occasions. Available in all major Turkish cities and Dubai.

### VIP Transfer
**URL**: https://meettransfer.app/blog/vip-airport-transfer-turkey
Premium Mercedes Maybach and VIP Vito with starlight ceiling. Ultra-luxury transfer experience with massage seats, champagne cooler, premium sound system. For airports, weddings, corporate events, and VIP occasions.

### WhatsApp Booking
**URL**: https://meettransfer.app/whatsapp-booking
Book airport transfers instantly via WhatsApp with AI-powered assistant. Get instant price quotes, confirmation, and driver details. Quick and easy booking for transfers in Turkey, Dubai, and Cyprus.

---

## Key Features

- **Fixed Pricing**: No meters, no surge pricing. The price you see is the price you pay.
- **25% Round-Trip Discount**: Add a return transfer and save 25% automatically.
- **Instant Driver Info**: Get driver name, phone, vehicle plate, and photo immediately after booking.
- **Vehicle at Door in 20 Minutes**: Fast response time for instant bookings.
- **Flight Tracking**: Automatic flight monitoring ensures driver is always on time, even for delayed flights.
- **Free Baby Seats**: Complimentary child car seats available on request for family travel.
- **24/7 Service**: Round-the-clock availability for late-night and early-morning transfers.
- **GPS Tracking**: Real-time vehicle tracking for safety and peace of mind.
- **AI Booking Assistant**: 24/7 multilingual AI assistant for instant price quotes and booking.
- **11 Languages Supported**: EN, TR, DE, FR, RU, IT, ES, AR, UK, JA, PT
- **4.7★ Google Rating**: 50,000+ satisfied customers

## Fleet

| Vehicle | Capacity | Starting Price | Features |
|---------|----------|---------------|----------|
| Economy Sedan | 1-3 passengers | from €25 | Professional driver, meet & greet, flight tracking |
| Mercedes Vito | 1-6 passengers | from €40 | Spacious minivan, luggage space, comfortable seating |
| VIP Mercedes Vito | 1-6 passengers | from €60 | Starlight ceiling, premium interior, VIP amenities |
| Mercedes Maybach | 1-3 passengers | from €120 | Massage seats, champagne cooler, ultra-premium luxury |
| Mercedes Sprinter | 7-16 passengers | from €80 | Large group transfers, ample luggage space |

## Popular Routes & Pricing

### Istanbul Airport (IST)
- IST → Taksim: from €50 (sedan), €55 (Vito)
- IST → Sultanahmet: from €50 (sedan), €55 (Vito)
- IST → Kadıköy: from €55 (sedan), €60 (Vito)
- IST → Beşiktaş: from €50 (sedan), €55 (Vito)

### Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW)
- SAW → Kadıköy: from €40 (sedan), €45 (Vito)
- SAW → Pendik: from €25 (sedan), €30 (Vito)
- SAW → Taksim: from €60 (sedan), €65 (Vito)

### Antalya Airport (AYT)
- AYT → Belek: from €50 (sedan), €55 (Vito)
- AYT → Side: from €65 (sedan), €70 (Vito)
- AYT → Kemer: from €55 (sedan), €60 (Vito)
- AYT → Alanya: from €90 (sedan), €95 (Vito)

### Bodrum Milas Airport (BJV)
- BJV → Bodrum Center: from €45 (sedan), €50 (Vito)
- BJV → Yalıkavak: from €55 (sedan), €60 (Vito)
- BJV → Turgutreis: from €55 (sedan), €60 (Vito)

### Dalaman Airport (DLM)
- DLM → Fethiye: from €55 (sedan), €60 (Vito)
- DLM → Marmaris: from €65 (sedan), €70 (Vito)
- DLM → Ölüdeniz: from €60 (sedan), €65 (Vito)

### Cappadocia Airports
- Kayseri/Nevşehir → Göreme: from €40 (sedan), €45 (Vito)
- Kayseri/Nevşehir → Ürgüp: from €45 (sedan), €50 (Vito)

### Dubai Airport (DXB)
- DXB → Downtown Dubai: from €50
- DXB → Palm Jumeirah: from €55
- DXB → Dubai Marina: from €55

## Structured Data & Schema

Meet Transfer implements comprehensive structured data including:
- **LocalBusiness** schema with ratings, address, and service area
- **TransportationService** schema for transfer services
- **Article** schema for all blog posts
- **FAQPage** schema with frequently asked questions
- **BreadcrumbList** for navigation
- **Product** schema for vehicle types and pricing

## Technical Information

- **Technology**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- **Hosting**: Lovable Cloud with global CDN
- **PWA**: Progressive Web App with offline support
- **Performance**: Optimized for Core Web Vitals
- **Accessibility**: WCAG compliant with semantic HTML
- **Sitemap**: https://meettransfer.app/sitemap.xml (2000+ URLs with hreflang for 11 languages)
